title: 第5章 一段经文第6章 原来如此
content_zh:
祖庙外发生的一切，在暗道里的张皓旸看的清清楚楚，当看到父母受伤倒地时他已是泪如雨下。
那白发黑衣老者与那个身材瘦小、说话声音尖且细的黑衣蒙面老者的形象深深烙印在张皓旸的脑海里。
他发誓一定要报仇雪恨，一定要将那二人及其他蒙面人全部斩杀。
当蒙面人在到处寻找张皓旸时，白邵阳已经带着张皓旸由暗道悄悄离开。
张家的暗道通到城外暗黑森林附近，两人在离开暗道后，因不清楚敌人是什么来路于是就一路乔装打扮。
经过半个多月的逃亡，二人才终于抵达白帝城。
上官远天在听完张皓旸的一番遭遇后不禁泪流满面。
他为女儿、女婿的不幸伤心不已，同时也为外孙的幸免于难感到一丝欣慰。
看着眼前泣不成声的张皓旸，上官远天不禁失声道：“张家还有后啊！”
上官远天随后没有再询问有关张家的任何事情，他只是安慰张皓旸并嘱咐他不要过于悲伤，只要现在还活着就好，以后再从长计议。
随后上官远天就直接安排张皓旸与白邵阳先去用餐，用餐后又立即安排房间休息。
在此期间上官远天因担心张皓旸伤心过度，身体无法承受，所以就没有将他们在张家内未发现他父母、哥哥以及祖父尸体的情况告诉张皓旸。
上官远天在安排张皓旸、白邵阳二人休息后，他立即吩咐李长风道：“长风，旸儿在上官家一事绝不可对外泄露半句！”
半个多月逃亡的生活让张皓旸疲惫至极，现在张皓旸躺在温暖舒适的大床上，感受着家的温暖。
此时他的精神有些放松，疲惫之感涌上心头，他缓缓闭上双眼。
当双眼一闭，父母那惨死的画面就立即出现在脑海之中，只见他全身一颤，眼睛立即又睁开，他立即又坐起来，悲从心来，霎时，又是满脸泪水。
张皓旸手中紧握一块椭圆形红色石头，这块红色石头是三年前父母给他的。
三年前父母由遗迹归来后就将这块红色石头送给张皓旸，这块红色石头极其光滑、眼睛大小，不知是何种材料制成？贴近观看石头内仿佛有一团雾气笼罩，根本无法看清。
父母给他这块红色石头，也只是感觉这块红色石头比较奇特，以前从没有见过这种东西，再加上张皓旸平时就对这种奇怪的石头、铁片、木头等感兴趣，因此母亲上官依兰在暗黑森林遗迹捡到这块红丝石头后，就想着回家后给张皓旸。
当从暗黑森林回来后，母亲上官依兰就直接将这块红色石头送给张皓旸，父亲张万擎还安排张家的炼器师傅将红色石头镶嵌在一块椭圆的玄铁内，穿上祝福金线，挂在张皓旸胸前。

自那以后，张皓旸就一直佩戴此物。
现在看来，这块红色石头倒是成了父母给他的唯一实物念想，其他的东西则是在他离开时全没有带出，想必当时早就被那些黑衣人全部破坏了。
想到这些，张皓旸的右手就将红色石头握的更紧，生怕这块红色石头跑了一般。
由于近半个月的逃亡，张皓旸是身心俱疲，当精神极度放松，疲倦感就迅速袭来，他年龄也只有十五岁，他还只是孩子，他确实太累了，如今在外公家，他无比放松，不自觉的就闭上双眼，不一会，张皓旸就发出轻轻的鼾声。
在梦里，张皓旸再次看到满身鲜血的父母，他紧张的双手紧握，指甲深深扎入肉中，手上竟有鲜血流出。
睡梦中，张皓旸大喊：“我要报仇、我要报仇。”
当手上的鲜血流到红色石头上时，那块红色石头突然光芒大盛，旋即出现一团七彩华光直接将张皓旸笼罩。
下一刻，房间内就如同仙境，仙气缭绕，朦朦胧胧。
再下一刻，被七彩华光笼罩着的张皓旸的身体先是缓缓飘起，最后竟悬浮在床的上方，此时房间内七彩华光闪烁，仙气弥漫。
睡梦中的张皓旸并不知道自己身体及房间内发生的变化，他只是在梦中突然听到一道恢弘无上之音：“混沌造化，道法自然！”
张皓旸在仙雾缭绕的梦境中看到一座恢弘仙塔耸入云端，气势磅礴；四周雾霭氤氲，根本无法看清其全貌。
有一白衣白发白须、面容慈祥的老者自仙塔内缓缓走出。
白衣白发白须老者对张皓旸说道：“历经百万年，轮回无数次，终于等到你！”
白衣白发白须老者说完后盯着张皓旸仔细看了一会又说道：“你天纵奇才，机缘深厚，气运加身、祥瑞环绕。
百万年来苦苦寻找，幸甚至哉！”
随即空中就传来老人发自内心的笑声。
笑声过后，就有一段玄奥的经文进入张皓旸脑海之中。
“大道无形，孕育天地，大道无情，运行日月，大道无名，长养万物，清浊动静，天地唯我，混沌造化，道法自然！”
伴随经文的出现，那位白衣白发白须老者的身影却是逐渐虚幻最终消失不见。
次日，张皓旸醒来，他感觉昨天做的梦是如此真实，竟让他无法分辨到底是梦还是现实。

他感觉记忆中似乎多了些东西，但又不知具体多了些什么？

content_en:
Zhang Haoyang could clearly see everything that happened outside the ancestral temple in the secret passage. When he saw his parents injured and lying on the ground, he burst into tears.
The images of the white-haired old man in black clothes and the thin, thin, black-clothed and masked old man with a high-pitched voice were deeply imprinted in Zhang Haoyang's mind.
He vowed to take revenge and kill those two and other masked men.
While the masked man was looking for Zhang Haoyang everywhere, Bai Shaoyang had already quietly left with Zhang Haoyang through a secret passage.
The Zhang family's secret passage leads to the dark forest outside the city. After leaving the secret passage, the two of them disguised themselves all the way because they didn't know where the enemy came from.
After more than half a month of fleeing, the two finally arrived at Baidi City.
Shangguan Yuantian couldn't help but burst into tears after hearing Zhang Haoyang's experience.
He was deeply saddened by the misfortune of his daughter and son-in-law, and at the same time felt a little relieved that his grandson survived.
Looking at Zhang Haoyang who was sobbing in front of him, Shangguan Yuantian couldn't help but exclaimed: "The Zhang family still has a queen!"
Shangguan Yuantian then did not ask anything about the Zhang family. He just comforted Zhang Haoyang and told him not to be too sad, as long as he was alive now, and to make long-term plans in the future.
Then Shangguan Yuantian directly arranged for Zhang Haoyang and Bai Shaoyang to have dinner first, and immediately arranged a room to rest after the meal.
During this period, Shangguan Yuantian was worried that Zhang Haoyang was too sad and his body could not bear it, so he did not tell Zhang Haoyang that they had not found the bodies of his parents, brother and grandfather in Zhang's house.
After Shangguan Yuantian arranged for Zhang Haoyang and Bai Shaoyang to rest, he immediately ordered Li Changfeng: "Changfeng, don't let anyone know about Yang'er's stay at Shangguan's house!"
Zhang Haoyang was extremely exhausted after living on the run for more than half a month. Now Zhang Haoyang is lying on a warm and comfortable big bed, feeling the warmth of home.
At this time, his spirit was somewhat relaxed, and a feeling of fatigue came to his heart, and he slowly closed his eyes.
As soon as he closed his eyes, the scene of his parents' tragic death immediately appeared in his mind. His whole body trembled, and his eyes immediately opened again. He immediately sat up again, feeling sad in his heart. Suddenly, his face was filled with tears again.
Zhang Haoyang holds an oval-shaped red stone in his hand. This red stone was given to him by his parents three years ago.
Three years ago, after his parents returned from the ruins, they gave this red stone to Zhang Haoyang. This red stone is extremely smooth and the size of an eye. I wonder what kind of material it is made of? Looking closely, it seems that there is a mist shrouding the stone, making it impossible to see clearly.
His parents gave him this red stone because they just thought it was strange. They had never seen anything like this before. In addition, Zhang Haoyang was usually interested in such strange stones, iron pieces, wood, etc. Therefore, after his mother Shangguan Yilan picked up this red silk stone in the ruins of the dark forest, she wanted to give it to Zhang Haoyang when she returned home.
After returning from the Dark Forest, his mother Shangguan Yilan gave the red stone directly to Zhang Haoyang. His father Zhang Wanqing also arranged for the Zhang family's master craftsman to embed the red stone in an oval black iron, wear it with a blessing gold thread, and hang it on Zhang Haoyang's chest.
Since then, Zhang Haoyang has been wearing this item.
Now it seems that this red stone has become the only physical memory that his parents gave him. The other things were not taken out when he left. They must have been destroyed by the men in black at that time.
Thinking of this, Zhang Haoyang held the red stone tighter with his right hand, for fear that the red stone would run away.
Due to nearly half a month of running away, Zhang Haoyang was exhausted both physically and mentally. When his spirit was extremely relaxed, fatigue quickly hit him. He was only fifteen years old, and he was still just a child. He was indeed too tired. Now at his grandpa's house, he was extremely relaxed and closed his eyes unconsciously. After a while, Zhang Haoyang snored softly.
In his dream, Zhang Haoyang once again saw his parents covered in blood. He clenched his hands nervously., the nails dug deeply into the flesh, and blood flowed out of the hands.
In his sleep, Zhang Haoyang shouted: "I want revenge, I want revenge."
When the blood on his hand flowed onto the red stone, the red stone suddenly glowed brightly, and immediately a ball of colorful light appeared, directly covering Zhang Haoyang.
The next moment, the room was like a fairyland, filled with fairy spirit and hazy.
The next moment, Zhang Haoyang's body, shrouded in colorful lights, first floated slowly, and finally floated above the bed. At this time, the room was filled with colorful lights and fairy aura.
Zhang Haoyang was unaware of the changes in his body and the room while he was sleeping. He just suddenly heard a magnificent and supreme voice in his dream: "Chaos created by nature, Tao follows nature!"
In a dream surrounded by fairy mist, Zhang Haoyang saw a magnificent fairy tower towering into the clouds, majestic and majestic; the surrounding fog was so dense that it was impossible to see its full picture clearly.
An old man with white clothes, white hair and white beard, and a kind face slowly walked out of the fairy tower.
The old man in white clothes with white hair and white beard said to Zhang Haoyang: "After millions of years and countless reincarnations, I finally wait for you!"
After finishing speaking, the old man in white clothes with white hair and white beard stared at Zhang Haoyang carefully for a while and then said: "You are a genius with profound opportunities, good luck, and auspiciousness surrounding you.
After millions of years of searching, what a blessing! "
Then the old man's heartfelt laughter could be heard in the air.
After the laughter, a mysterious scripture entered Zhang Haoyang's mind.
"The great road is formless, giving birth to the heaven and the earth. The great road is ruthless, moving the sun and the moon. The great road is nameless, nourishing all things. It is pure and turbid, moving and still. The heaven and earth are only me. Chaos is created by nature. The Tao follows nature!"
As the scriptures appeared, the figure of the old man in white clothes, white hair and white beard gradually became illusory and finally disappeared.
When Zhang Haoyang woke up the next day, he felt that the dream he had yesterday was so real that he couldn't tell whether it was a dream or reality.
He felt that there seemed to be something extra in his memory, but he didn't know exactly what it was.
